problem: 'Years on one cell' is ambiguous in a cellular chapter; a student may read 'cell' as a radio cell (base station) rather than a battery cell.
fix: Write 'Years on one battery cell' (or 'years on one battery'), matching the wording used in Section 2.

where: Section 2 message paragraph and Worked example 1
problem: Section 2 says the sensor sends a state change plus a heartbeat every 5 minutes, but the worked example silently counts only one 60-byte message per slot per 5 minutes. A student may not see why the extra state-change messages are ignored.
fix: Add one line to the example: 'Assume only the periodic heartbeat is counted; each state-change message adds extra traffic on top of this average.'

problem: 'tens of kB, roughly a thousand times the 60-byte message' is loose arithmetic: 20 kB is about 330 times 60 B, and only about 60 kB reaches a thousand times.
fix: Say 'tens of kB, several hundred to a thousand times the 60-byte message (a 30 kB frame is about 500 times 60 B)'.

fix: Make it a link: 'see 6.5 for the water chain in detail'.
